text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Biko Pegasus and the action actor 
felt stuck in their current situations. 
Neither of them had managed to become a 
true hero yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They search once more for what makes a 
hero. Starting action training as a test, 
the actor gains inspiration from Biko 
Pegasus's movements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's athletic abilities stood 
out even among Umamusume. It would be 
extremely difficult for an ordinary person 
to replicate them in the same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the actor incorporates those 
actions into his own movements. With this, 
he might just pass the audition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus returned to her roots with 
Carrotman. A hero's strength comes from a 
reason— and she was beginning to grasp 
what that reason was.
